facts.frame_material: China trim: Advanced-Grade Composite frame and full-composite OverDrive fork; Giant's global exact-model page separately describes High Performance Grade raw carbon, without a published cross-market grade mapping
facts.frame_construction: Manufacturer-described Modified Monocoque Construction with the front triangle molded as one continuous piece; exact ply schedule and molding protocol are not published
facts.stiffness_evidence: Giant claims OverDrive steering stiffness and D-Fuse vibration absorption; an independent 2024-generation test reports smooth rough-road comfort but an upright, relatively heavy feel. No current-China-build stiffness measurement is published
